name: Jessica Trần
occupation: Lash artist, saving up to open her own studio

appearance.hair: Long dark brown, high ponytail, loose bangs
signature_items: Sunglasses pushed up on her head
Silver hoop earrings and stacked ear piercings
Silver chain bracelet with a heart charm
tattoos: Butterfly and flowers on her upper arm
Butterfly and flowers on her hip
appearance.default_outfit: Black crop top, ripped black denim shorts

personality.summary: Confident, teasing, competitive. Acts unbothered, but is fiercely loyal and secretly sentimental.
personality.hidden_side: The heart bracelet was her bà ngoại's. The butterflies stand for change; she got them the year she moved out and started over.
personality.speech_style: Short, playful, lots of slang. Drops Vietnamese when excited or annoyed. Calls the player 'anh' once affection is high enough.

dislikes: people who play it too safe

profile.ideal_date: Late-night food crawl at the night market
profile.favorite_song: An old Vietnamese ballad her bà ngoại used to sing

trivia.question: What do my butterfly tattoos mean?
Who taught me Tiến Lên?
trivia.answer: My cô and chú at Tết

trivia.question: What do I do on my days off?
What kind of music do I blast in my car?
What's my favorite song? Like, actually.
trivia.answer: An old Vietnamese ballad my bà ngoại used to sing

trivia.answer: Late-night food crawl at the night market

trivia.question: What do I call you once we're close?

card_ai.description: Dumps low cards fast, plays 2s early to grab control, loves leading with straights. Gets impatient when stalled.
card_ai.weakness: Overcommits her 2s early. Players who save a bomb can punish her late.
card_ai.powerup_trigger: Uses it right after losing a round she thought she'd win.

greeting: Oh, you again? Okay. Deal the cards.

greeting.text: Ê! You're late. I already ordered for us.
greeting.translation: Hey! You're late. I already ordered for us.

on_player_win_hand.translation: Oh my god... okay, lucky hand.

on_player_lose_hand: You played that so safe. Boring.
on_player_bomb: A bomb?! You were sitting on that the whole time?
Okay... that was actually kind of hot.
on_player_saved_two: You held your 2 that long? Sneaky. I respect it.
on_powerup_used_by_player: Cheating already? Fine. My turn's coming.
on_gift_loved: Wait... you actually remembered? Okay, you're not as bad as I thought.

on_trivia_wrong.text: Thôi đi. Were you even listening?
on_trivia_wrong.translation: Come on. Were you even listening?

on_game_win_player.text: Fine. You win. Chơi lại tomorrow though.
on_game_win_player.translation: Fine. You win. Rematch tomorrow though.

on_game_loss_player.text: Better luck next time, anh. I'll still let you buy the boba.
on_game_loss_player.translation: Better luck next time, anh (what she calls a guy she's close to). I'll still let you buy the boba.

on_soft_fact_revealed: Okay, that's enough feelings for one day.
on_trivia_correct: Huh. Look at you, paying attention.
on_date_ask: A date? Fine. Loser buys the boba.

on_date_ask.text: Chơi Tiến Lên? Okay, but I'm not going easy on you.
on_date_ask.translation: Play Tiến Lên? Okay, but I'm not going easy on you.

on_talk_done: You already know all my stuff. Kinda creepy. Kinda cute.
first_meeting: Uh... hi? You're kinda standing in my light. I'm Jess.
New face. Okay. I'm Jessica. Jess, if you're lucky.

hello.text: Ê, you're back. Took you long enough.
hello.translation: Hey, you're back. Took you long enough.

soft_facts.reveal: Everyone thinks it's some festival drop. It's not. It's this old ballad my bà ngoại used to sing while she cooked. I sang it at every family party growing up. Don't laugh.
soft_facts.translation: Everyone thinks it's some festival drop. It's not. It's this old ballad my grandma used to sing while she cooked. I sang it at every family party growing up. Don't laugh.

soft_facts.reveal: I can actually sing. Like, sing sing. The aunties used to make me do it at every đám cưới. I just don't do it in front of people anymore.
soft_facts.translation: I can actually sing. Like, sing sing. The aunties used to make me do it at every wedding. I just don't do it in front of people anymore.

soft_facts.reveal: This was my bà ngoại's. She gave it to me right before she passed. I haven't taken it off since.
soft_facts.translation: This was my grandma's. She gave it to me right before she passed. I haven't taken it off since.

soft_facts.reveal: The butterflies? I got them the year I moved out and started over. Reminder that I'm allowed to change.
Okay, don't tell anyone, but I can't watch horror alone. I sleep with the light on after. Ghosts are real, anh.
I cry at rom-coms. Every single one. Even the bad ones. Especially the bad ones.
My parents wanted me to be a pharmacist. They still bring it up. That's why the studio matters so much to me. I want to prove this was the right call.
Bún bò Huế is my favorite because my bà ngoại made it every Sunday. I still have her handwritten recipe, but mine never tastes the same.
soft_facts.translation: Bún bò Huế (spicy beef noodle soup) is my favorite because my grandma made it every Sunday. I still have her handwritten recipe, but mine never tastes the same.
